seo.title: Tender response
seo.seo_description: Tender response: a WorkStudio starter template for small business. Starting fields, steps, human approval and what is left to validate with your adviser.

blocks.role: Promesse de la fiche : ce que fait le gabarit « Réponse à un appel d'offres », dit sans détour.

translation.headline: Tender response.
translation.subheadline: The Tender response template checks each requirement in the specification against your material (covered, partly covered or not covered), then drafts a first version of the response.

blocks.role: Réponse d'abord : ce que fait le gabarit, en trois lignes.

translation.title: The short answer.
translation.body:
The Tender response template checks each requirement in the specification against your material (covered, partly covered or not covered), then drafts a first version of the response. For an uncovered requirement it asserts nothing: it writes a placeholder in brackets: "[à compléter]".

A workflow template is an automated sequence of tasks, provided as a starting point in WorkStudio and to be adapted to the business before it is deployed.

blocks.role: Les champs de départ du gabarit, tels que déclarés dans WorkStudio.

translation.title: What you provide.
translation.body:
Each starting field is pre-filled with an example value so a first run needs no typing, except email addresses and files.

  • The specification. Extract of the specification: requirements and selection criteria.
  • Your material. Your response material: offer, references, resources, price.

blocks.role: Les étapes du flux : ce que fait chaque agent, où une personne intervient.

cards.title: Analyze the requirements.
cards.text: An agent numbers each requirement, says whether it is covered, cites the element concerned, then lists what is missing and recalls the selection criteria.

cards.title: Draft the first version.
cards.text: A second agent writes the response requirement by requirement, with the price in Canadian dollars before tax (GST and QST are added) and a box "Exigences non couvertes" to handle before sending.

cards.title: Review.
cards.text: You read the text produced, correct it if needed, then use or send it yourself: the template sends nothing.

blocks.role: Ce qui s'adapte avant l'usage : le propre du gabarit, le commun, l'envoi.

cards.title: What to adapt here.
cards.text: The template knows neither your references nor your price: whatever is not in your material stays to be completed. The price is written before tax, stating that GST and QST are added. A first version is not a bid ready to file.

cards.title: What applies to all.
cards.text: The templates are written for a Quebec small business: amounts in Canadian dollars, GST and QST wherever a tax applies, and Quebec business vocabulary. They do not guarantee any tax or legal compliance: the examples are fictional, and your accountant or adviser validates the result before use.

cards.title: Nothing is sent.
cards.text: The template produces text to review. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

blocks.role: Questions de la fiche : envoi, point propre au gabarit, adaptation au Québec.

items.question: Does this template send anything for me?
items.answer: No. It produces text to review; you use or send it yourself. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

items.question: Does the template invent references?
items.answer: No. For a requirement your material does not cover, it writes "[à compléter]" in brackets rather than asserting anything.

items.question: Is it suited to a Quebec business?
items.answer: It is written for Quebec but still needs validating: the examples are fictional, and the template does not replace your accountant or adviser. Review every result before using it and adapt the instructions to your business.

blocks.role: Appel à l'action : démonstration sur données fictives.

translation.title: See it at work.
translation.text: A demonstration on fictional data, to see what the template prepares and where a person stays in control.
